description: I’m tired of hearing that Sen. Susan Collins is responsible for the Supreme Court. Look at the actual record. Yes, she voted to confirm Republican nominees. She also voted to confirm Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan and Ketanji Brown Jackson, every one of the court’s three liberal justices. No other Republican serving today can claim that. […]
